commit.message:
pngsave: write text chunks as iTXt (#5249)

* pngsave: write text chunks as iTXt

iTXt chunks are for international data and contain utf-8 rather than
latin1. Things like XMP are supposed to be in uncompressed iTXt.

Thanks tonymarklove

Closes https://github.com/libvips/libvips/issues/5248
